name: mclust.options
title: Default values for use with MCLUST package

origin.description: Set or retrieve default values for use with MCLUST package.

arguments.text: One or more arguments in name = value form, or no argument at all. Available names are emModelNames, hcModelName, hcUse, subset, fillEllipses, bicPlotSymbols, bicPlotColors, classPlotSymbols, classPlotColors, and warn.

origin.details: With no arguments the current list is returned. A single unnamed character argument returns one option. A single unnamed list replaces named options. Named arguments update the session defaults and return the full list invisibly.
origin.value: The current option list, one option, or the updated list invisibly after a set.
origin.example:
opt <- mclust.options()
mclust.options(subset = 2500)
print(mclust.options("subset"))
mclust.options(opt)
print(mclust.options("subset"))

translation.description: Set or retrieve default values for use with MCLUST package.

arguments.name: *args
arguments.text: With no arguments the current dict is returned. One string argument returns one option. One dict argument updates named options.

arguments.name: **kwargs
arguments.text: Named options to update, using the same names as in R.

translation.details: With no arguments the current dict is returned. A single string argument returns one option. A single dict replaces named options. Keyword arguments update the session defaults and return the full dict.
translation.value: The current option dict, one option, or the updated dict after a set.
translation.example:
from mclust.mclust_options import mclust_options, print_mclust_option

opt = mclust_options()
mclust_options(subset=2500)
print_mclust_option(mclust_options("subset"))
mclust_options(opt)
print_mclust_option(mclust_options("subset"))
